info.title: WMS inventory backend
info.description: Inventory API backed by PostgreSQL kernel commands. OIDC JWT access tokens identify users; database grants authorize warehouses and owners. PostgreSQL is the sole business guard evaluator; the host validates module configuration. Trusted compiled modules and bounded declarative policies are supported. Product licensing is not selected yet.

get.summary: List warehouse documents with planned and fulfilled lines
get.description: Requires document.read. Supports owner_id and bound pagination; item, position and document_line filters are rejected.

post.description: Creates all planned lines atomically. Requires document.create for the owner. Up to 200 lines; quantities use the SKU scale. Idempotency includes the complete request.

get.description: Includes planned, reserved and fulfilled line quantities.

post.summary: Activate, close or cancel a warehouse document
post.description: Requires document.transition. Locks the document and checks expected version. draft -> active/cancelled, active -> closed/cancelled. Closing requires every line fulfilled and zero reservations. Cancellation requires no fulfilled or reserved quantity. Closed/cancelled documents cannot reopen.
